name: Tabletop Fantasy War
detailed_description:
Tabletop Fantasy War is a turn-based strategy wargame inspired by classic tabletop games. Design and deploy your units groups in battlegrounds and command them to victory through strategic movements. Manage your economy and deploy structures to upgrade and support your units groups or to downgrade and attack your opponents. Conquer neutral bases and expand your territory to improve your economy and to corner your opponents. But remember... your units is all what you have. Every decision matters. Every battle can turn the balance. Will you keep them alive? Will you drive them to victory?

Current gameplay features:

  • Create your units groups in the HUB before playing a match.

  • Combine different units to make groups with unique upgrades and stats.

  • Use your economy to deploy your units groups in the battleground.

  • Deploy structures in your territory to research and apply upgrades on your units groups or to cast attacks and downgrade your opponents.

  • Conquer neutral and other's players bases to expand your territory and improve your economy.

  • Move your units groups to beneficial terrains to improve their stats.

  • Change your groups formation to adapt their stats to each situation (offensive, defensive, mobility and guard formations).

  • Preview the combats and decide when to engage your opponents. Keep in mind that your units cannot be replaced!

  • Take down all your opponents units to win the match. 

  • Play multiplayer local against other human and/or computer-controller players and online against other human players.

Expected features full-game release:

  • Single player campaign mode.

    • with many more customizable options for your units groups in the HUB that are unlocked as you progress on the campaign.

    • with rewards to your units group that perform well in battlegrounds.

    • with specific gameplay modalities adapted to the storyline.

    • with different progression lines and endings.

  • More gameplay modalities for multiplayer.
